newsitem.title: USA: Personnel Group NurseFinders unit growing.
newsitem.headline: Personnel Group NurseFinders unit growing.

text.p: Personnel Group of America Inc, a diversified personnel staffing company, said on Thursday its NurseFinders unit was growing at double-digit rates, and the company's overall outlook remained positive.

While some staffing services companies recently announced near-term pressures due to a concentration of national account staffing business and their Medicare business, Personnel said its outlook was very positive because it focused on local and regional accounts.
The company said it derived less than 10 percent of its total system-wide revenues from Medicare.
On the health care staffing side, or NurseFinders, Personnel said: "We offer a broad spectrum of health care staffing services and only a small percentage of our business is Medicare related."

Personnel said it remained committed to its growth strategy of pursuing attractive acquisitions of staffing services and information technology staffing companies which have built strong local reputations.
